title: Entitled Woman Forces Cops to Drag Her from The Church
description:
An avid churchgoer became the center of attention at the Sunday mass when the management decided to trespass her for causing problems to other patrons. When officers arrived, she refused to budge from her seat, having left her dignity at the door. The pious woman continued her prayers outside the church by replying belligerently, scratching and kicking the officers trying to detain her. The female was charged with battery on a law enforcement officer, resisting with violence and trespassing.
